title: Companion code for 'From Hand-Crafted to LLM-Based Variation Operators in Metaheuristics: A Tutorial'
description:
Runnable reference implementation for the tutorial. The build-and-validate loop (Algorithm 1) is implemented twice, in Python and in C++17, and both are compared against the same frozen output: if they disagree, the algorithm as written in the paper is under-specified.

Includes a transient numeric-conditioned operator (TSP), an amortized code-emitting operator (online bin packing), the drop-channel ablation behind the placement rule, five notebooks, and reproduce.py, which runs all of it and reports what matched. Everything runs offline: a deterministic mock model returns completions from a fixed pool, so no API key and no network are needed. Python 3.9+, standard library only; the notebooks additionally need Jupyter.
